competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Implement and monitor infection control policies and procedures: natutukoy ng BHW ang posibleng daan ng pagkalat nang walang diagnosis, nakapagmumungkahi ng magkakaugnay na kontrol na may tamang responsable, naipapakita ang wastong paglilinis ng kamay at pag-ubo, natutulungan ang pamilya sa mas ligtas na pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon, at naitatala ang patakaran, training gap at IPC gap ng BHS hanggang sa may ebidensiya ng follow-up.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Implement and monitor infection control policies and procedures: the BHW identifies possible transmission routes without diagnosing anyone, proposes layered controls with appropriate owners, demonstrates correct hand hygiene and cough etiquette, helps a household toward safer food, water and sanitation, and records BHS policies, training gaps and IPC gaps through to follow-up evidence.
